about: Names that look like internal development codes but have to stay, and files whose cleanup is planned separately. check_internal_codes.py accepts a hit only when this file covers it. Add a name here only with the reason it cannot be renamed.

names.name: desktop-desktop-review-v1
names.kept_because: Installed copies check this value in an update package. With another value they would refuse the update.

names.name: E2_DATA_REVIEW
names.kept_because: Id of the data review step. It is saved in settings and in task records, and the pages and the service both use it.

names.name: E2_LOGIC_REVIEW
names.kept_because: Id of the logic review step. It is saved in settings and in task records, and the pages and the service both use it.

names.name: synthetic_offline_d38
names.kept_because: Name of the offline sample capture channel. It is saved in the session state.

names.name: E6_IDENTITY_INDEXED
names.kept_because: Event name saved in the research work index.

names.name: Desktop_DESKTOP_METADATA
names.kept_because: Producer name saved in metadata acquisition records.

names.name: Desktop_DESKTOP_RESEARCH_REPORTS_SUCCESSOR
names.kept_because: Producer name inside saved report digests. The digest id is a hash over it, so a new name would change the id of every digest.

names.name: desktop-desktop-research_reports/1.0
names.kept_because: Generator version inside saved report digests. The digest id is a hash over it.

names.name: Desktop_DESKTOP_PUBLIC_METADATA_V2
names.kept_because: Profile id saved in metadata request records.

names.name: Desktop_DESKTOP_USER_REQUEST
names.kept_because: Evidence class saved in metadata request records.

names.name: DesktopDesktopMetadataAttempt-v1
names.kept_because: Format name of saved metadata request records.

names.name: DesktopDesktopMetadataResult-v1
names.kept_because: Format name of saved metadata result records.

names.name: Desktop_Core_VERTICAL_Capabilities_SUCCESSOR_V2
names.kept_because: Capability revision saved in the settings snapshot of each task.

names.name: Desktop_DESKTOP_Core_BRIDGE
names.kept_because: Execution channel saved in the settings snapshot of each task.

names.name: desktop-desktop-local-v1
names.kept_because: Revision of the default capability list saved with the settings.

names.name: accounting_recovery-legacy-price-migration-candidate001
names.kept_because: Id of the price list. It is saved with every cost record.

names.name: candidate001-r1
names.kept_because: Revision of the price list. It is saved with every cost record.

names.name: "revision": "candidate001"
names.kept_because: Revision written into the hand-over objects of model calls, which are saved in task records.

names.name: "adapter_manifest_revision": "candidate001"
names.kept_because: Revision written into the hand-over objects of the local embedding adapter. Changing it changes the identity of those objects.

names.name: @candidate001
names.kept_because: Part of the object ids of saved model-call results.

names.name: channel_contracts/candidate001/common-objects.schema.json
names.kept_because: Id of a data format description. Saved objects and the other format descriptions refer to it.

names.name: desktop-evo-e2-local-v1
names.kept_because: Revision of the default capability list. It is saved with the settings.

names.name: E11-existing-schemas-v1
names.kept_because: Id of the data migration in the update protocol. Installed updaters check it in an update package.

names.name: SOURCE_CONNECTORS_LITERATURE_DISCOVERY_20260810_190016_candidate002
names.kept_because: Run id constant of the literature connector framework, restored unchanged with the code that was removed in this round.
